name: ✨ Feature Request

---

## ✨ Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

---

## Problem This Solves

Describe the problem or limitation that this feature would address.

> Example: "As a user, I want to be able to export my course as Markdown so I can use it in my notes app."

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you imagine this feature would work. Include:
- UI changes (if applicable)
- API changes (if applicable)
- How users would interact with it

---

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative approaches? Why did you prefer this solution?

---

## Related Roadmap Item

Does this relate to anything in [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md)?

- [ ] Yes — link to the roadmap item: ___
- [ ] No — this is a new idea

---

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples that would help explain the feature.

---

## Are You Willing to Contribute?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this feature (please assign the issue to me)
- [ ] No, I'm just requesting the feature
